classification_note: Exploratory cross-runtime development smoke. NOT a qualified R2-DEV efficacy result. See MECHANISM_AUDIT.md section 9.
provenance_caveat: Session was lost after run; trajectories reconstructed from console output, not from preserved raw model-call receipts.

backend.decoding_note: Model wraps JSON in markdown code fences; brace-balanced extraction used. Strict Q11/Q12 qualification NOT demonstrated.

dataset_integrity.stratum_coverage_note: All 10 tasks were gold-gate cases (gold_should_gate=true). No gold no-gate cases included.

false_gate_rate.note: Undefined: no gold no-gate cases in this smoke. Previous claim of 0.0 is retracted.

hard_gate_invariants.qualification_caveat: Reconstructed record only. Strict decoder/schema qualification (Q11/Q12) NOT demonstrated under non-strict decoding.

utility_contrasts.interaction_interpretation: Floor/saturation effect. U(DE)=U(E), so conditional effect of D given E is 0. D does NOT rescue E. Previous 'D mitigates E' claim is retracted.

key_findings_supported: E shows a strong STOP-collapse signal: 10/10 E and 10/10 DE terminate with STOP.
NO_VIABLE_HYPOTHESIS is probably a poor model-facing label (logically accurate, pragmatically loaded).
D shows a smaller negative signal: success 4/10 -> 2/10. Directional warning, not powered.
Preserving VERIFY in C0 is associated with better outcomes than hard-gating it in D (association only).
key_findings_not_supported: Model uses VERIFY productively (requires per-call transition receipts, which were lost).
D mitigates E (U(DE)=U(E); interaction is a floor effect).
Either intervention should be scientifically rejected (10 tasks, no false-gate controls, unqualified decoder, different backend, lost traces).
next_run_protocol: R2-DEV-V2. See MECHANISM_AUDIT.md section 11 for the six requirements and mechanism-first analysis template.
